metadata.name: sscre_protocol
metadata.description: SSCRE rewards: per-epoch merkle distributor funded from a reserve on a declining emission schedule, roots approved by an oracle quorum with a dispute delay and DAO veto, unclaimed funds clawed back

instructions.name: initialize_pool
docs: Creates the pool and reserve vault. Upgrade authority only; VCoin mint pinned.

instructions.name: start_epoch
docs: Funds the next epoch from the reserve (permissionless, rate-limited).

errors.name: InvalidProgramData
errors.msg: Program data account does not belong to this program

errors.name: InvalidVCoinMint
errors.msg: VCoin mint must be the vcoin-token program's mint PDA

errors.name: InvalidQuorum
errors.msg: Quorum must be between 2 and the number of registered oracles

errors.name: NotActiveOracle
errors.msg: Signer is not an active oracle

errors.name: EpochTooSoon
errors.msg: The previous epoch has not run its full duration

errors.name: NotVoting
errors.msg: Epoch is not accepting root votes

errors.name: InvalidRoot
errors.msg: Root must be non-zero and max_total_claim within (0, budget]

errors.name: RootDeadlinePassed
errors.msg: The root deadline passed; claw the budget back instead

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

types.name: AdminState
docs: Authority with a two-step, time-locked transfer.
`propose` (current authority) → wait [`AUTHORITY_TRANSFER_DELAY`] → `accept`
(new authority). The current authority can `cancel` at any time before acceptance.

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: `Pubkey::default()` when no transfer is pending.

fields.name: pending_since
docs: Unix time the pending transfer was proposed (0 when none).

types.name: ClaimStatus
docs: Marks one claimant's claim in one epoch, PDA `["claim", epoch, claimant]` (SSC-10: no
per-user epoch bitmap to run out of).

types.name: Epoch
docs: One distribution, PDA `["epoch", index]`, with its own vault `["epoch-vault", index]`
holding exactly its budget, so no epoch can pay out another's funds (SSC-02).

fields.name: proposed_root
docs: Candidate that reached quorum (`proposed_at == 0` = none).

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Fee snapshot at activation, so every claimant of an epoch pays the same rate.

fields.name: total_claimed
docs: Gross (before fee), like `max_total_claim` (SSC-13).

fields.name: key
docs: `Pubkey::default()` = empty slot.

fields.name: active_from
docs: Votes count only from this time on (registration + 24h).

fields.name: oracle
docs: `Pubkey::default()` = empty slot.

types.name: PoolConfig
docs: Singleton, PDA `["pool-config"]`. Owns the reserve vault and every epoch vault.

fields.name: admin
docs: Bootstrapped by the upgrade authority, handed to the Realms governance PDA.

fields.name: reserve_vault
docs: PDA `["reserve-vault"]`: the undistributed rewards (e.g. the 350M allocation).

fields.name: pending_fee_bps
docs: Timelocked fee change (`pending_fee_eta == 0` = none).

fields.name: max_epoch_budget
docs: Ceiling for any epoch's budget, fixed at initialization.

fields.name: pause_accum
docs: Total seconds spent paused, so deadlines can be extended by downtime (SSC-05).

fields.name: claim_window
docs: How long claims stay open after a root activates (also the deadline for activating one).

fields.name: dispute_delay
docs: Wait between a root reaching quorum and becoming claimable (DAO can veto meanwhile).

fields.name: decay_bps
docs: Each epoch's budget is the previous one × (1 − decay_bps / 10000).
